WITH supply_dates AS (
        SELECT product_id, date_supplied_from AS dt
        FROM Product_Suppliers
    ),
    order_dates AS (
        SELECT oi.product_id, co.order_date AS dt
        FROM Order_Items oi
        JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    ),
    all_dates AS (
        SELECT product_id, dt FROM supply_dates
        UNION ALL
        SELECT product_id, dt FROM order_dates
    )
SELECT p.product_id,
       MIN(ad.dt) AS earliest_date
FROM Products p

questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me out? I need to know all the details about products that were sourced in 2017—I want to see everything from the name to the supplier info and stuff. Oh, and also show me which of those products ended up being sold to our customers that year too! Thanks so much!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'products were sourced in 2017', I'm talking about when a supplier first started supplying that product to our company—that's the official start date of the supplier-product relationship.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.product_name,
    p.product_type_code,
    p.product_price,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.supplier_phone,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Customer_Orders co
        INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
        WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id
        AND strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = '2017'
    ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS sold_to_customers_in_2017
FROM Products p
INNER JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
INNER JOIN Suppliers s ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ps.date_supplied_from) = '2017'

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'products were sourced in 2017', I'm actually referring to when customer orders containing those products were placed in 2017—not when we got the products from suppliers.

    p.product_name,
    p.product_price,
    p.product_type_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.supplier_phone

JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
JOIN Product_Suppliers ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
JOIN Suppliers s ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', co.order_date) = '2017'
